problems.title: Three standard small-input limits
problems.question: Find lim as x→0 of ln(1+3xsinx)/arctan(x²).
problems.idea: Factor into ratios with known limits.

problems.title: Rationalize a difference of large roots
problems.question: Find lim as x→∞ of √(x²+ax+b)-√(x²+cx+d).
problems.idea: Multiply by the conjugate.
steps: Divide numerator and denominator by positive x.
The numerator tends to a-c and each denominator root tends to 1.

problems.title: Cancel before substituting
problems.question: Find lim as x→3 of 1/(x-3)-6/(x²-9).
problems.idea: Factor the quadratic denominator.

problems.title: An exponent tending to negative infinity
problems.question: Find lim as n→∞ of 2^((1-n²)/(3n+1)).
problems.idea: Compare the leading powers in the exponent.
steps: A fixed base greater than 1 raised to an exponent tending to -∞ tends to zero.

problems.title: Take logarithms of a power limit
problems.question: Find lim[(2n²+3)/(2n²-1)]^(1-n²).
problems.idea: The base is 1 plus a small quantity.
steps: The logarithm of the expression is (1-n²)ln(1+4/(2n²-1)).

problems.title: Force cancellation of a divergent linear term
problems.question: Given lim as x→∞ of (px²+1)/(qx+2)+x-2=-1, find pq.
problems.idea: A finite limit fixes both the leading term and constant.
steps: The limit becomes 2/q-2=-1, so q=2 and p=-2.
The case q=0 cannot yield a finite limit because the remaining polynomial still has its x term.

problems.title: Opposite bounds force simultaneous equality
problems.question: Count solutions of (sinx+cosx)²=log₅(|4x-π|+25).
problems.idea: The left side is at most 2, and the right side at least 2.
steps: Equality on the right forces x=π/4.
At that input the left side is also 2.
No other input can satisfy both bounds.

problems.title: Combine exponential bases
problems.question: Solve 10^(2x-3)4^(2-x)=0.08.
problems.idea: Collect constant factors and powers with exponent x.

problems.title: Factor after taking logarithms
problems.question: Solve 7^(x-5)>3^(x²+x-30).
problems.idea: Take logarithms to base 3.
steps: The roots are log₃7-6 and 5; the product is positive strictly between them.

problems.title: Derivative cancellation in a logarithmic sum
problems.question: Differentiate f(x)=arcsinx/√(1-x²)+ln√((1-x)/(1+x)).
problems.idea: Differentiate each part on -1<x<1.

problems.title: Differentiate the sum first
problems.question: Solve f′(x)+g′(x)<0 for f=(x²-1)/(x-3),g=1/(x-3).
problems.idea: Their sum is simpler than either derivative separately.
steps: The denominator is positive except at the excluded input 3.

problems.title: The derivative of a half-angle logarithm
problems.question: For f(x)=-ln(1/sinx+cotx), find f′(π/2)-f′(π/6).
problems.idea: Use cscx+cotx=(1+cosx)/sinx.
formulas: f′(x)=cscx on the local domains containing the two inputs.
steps: One way to derive this is -(cscx+cotx)′/(cscx+cotx)=cscx.
The two derivative values are 1 and 2.

problems.title: Nested radicals as powers of 3
problems.question: Evaluate log₉√(3∛(3√3))-log₉(27/⁴√3).
problems.idea: Reduce both arguments to single powers.

problems.title: A one-sided absolute-value limit
problems.question: Find the right-hand limit at π of (|sinx|-sinx)cotx.
problems.idea: Just to the right of π, sinx is negative.
steps: The expression becomes -2cosx on that one-sided neighbourhood.

problems.title: A zero factor simplifies the product rule
problems.question: Find f′(2) for f=(2x-2)(3-x²)(4x³-32).
problems.idea: At x=2 the last factor is zero.
steps: Only the term differentiating the last factor survives.

problems.title: Rotate a rectangle about a side
problems.question: A rectangle has diagonal 2 making angle α with one side. Find the lateral area of the solid obtained by rotation about a side.
problems.idea: The solid is a cylinder with side lengths as height and radius.
steps: The product of radius and height is 4sinαcosα, regardless of which side is the axis.

problems.title: Two cones from a rotating right triangle
problems.question: A right triangle with legs 15,20 rotates about its hypotenuse. Find the surface area.
problems.idea: The altitude to the hypotenuse is the common cone radius.
steps: The two cone generators are 15 and 20. Their shared base is internal, so it adds no exterior surface.

problems.title: Rotate an isosceles triangle about a leg
problems.question: A triangle with equal sides 5 and base 6 rotates about one equal side. Find surface area.
problems.idea: Its altitude to the axis becomes the common radius of two cones.
formulas: Triangle altitude to base=4; area=12; altitude to side 5=2·12/5=24/5.
steps: The rotating off-axis sides have lengths 5 and 6.

problems.title: Insphere of a regular tetrahedron
problems.question: A regular tetrahedron has edge 6 m. Find its insphere surface area.
problems.idea: Use its height and the centroid position.

problems.title: Angle at the middle named vertex
problems.question: A=(2,-1,3),B=(1,1,1),C=(0,0,5). Find cos∠ABC.
problems.idea: Both vectors must start at B.

problems.title: Two shapes share the same acute diagonal angle
problems.question: A cone frustum’s axial-section diagonals have length 6, divide each other 2:1, and make angle 60°. Find lateral area.
problems.idea: The base-radius ratio is 2:1, but the acute diagonal angle allows two aspect ratios.
formulas: Let R=2r. Then diagonal²=(3r)²+h²=36; lateral area=π(R+r)√(h²+(R-r)²).
steps: For h/(3r)=√3, we get r=1,h=3√3 and lateral area=6√7π.
For h/(3r)=1/√3, we get r=√3,h=3 and lateral area=18π.
In each case the acute angle between the diagonal lines is 60°, with the supplementary crossing angle 120°.
problems.answer: 6√7π or 18π m² under the acute-angle reading.
problems.note: Only 6√7π is listed. Specifying which pair of rays makes the 60° angle, or supplying the aspect ratio, is needed to select one shape.

problems.title: Two parallel candidates at a prescribed distance
problems.question: Find the listed line perpendicular to 5x+12y-1=0 and distance 2 from M=(3,1).
problems.idea: Every perpendicular line has the form 12x-5y+c=0.
steps: The two lines have c=-5 or -57.

problems.title: Several listed families are pencils
problems.question: Which listed equations describe a pencil of lines through one fixed point as a varies?
problems.idea: Find a point satisfying the equation for every a.
formulas: A pencil can be written L₁(x,y)+aL₂(x,y)=0, with a common intersection L₁=L₂=0.
steps: ay+5x-1=0 passes through (1/5,0) for every a.
ax+5y+a=0 passes through (-1,0) for every a.
The other parameter families are parallel lines, while 12x-5y=0 is just one fixed line.
problems.note: The question has at least three valid listed answers.

problems.title: Point-to-line distance
problems.question: Find the distance from N=(3,4) to y=3x-4.
problems.idea: Put the line in general form.
steps: The numerator is |9-4-4|=1 and the denominator √10.

problems.title: Use the acute angle between lines
problems.question: Find the cosine of the angle between the line through T=(-1,5),S=(2,1) and x/2-y/2=1.
problems.idea: Take their direction vectors.
